2608.28271.title: RECAST: Recent & Context-Aware Sampling for Test-Time Adaptation in Streaming Biosignals
2608.28271.paper_summary: Streaming biosignals vary across subjects and drift over time, so population-trained models lose accuracy during long-term monitoring. Test-time adaptation (TTA) enables online personalization by updating the model on incoming samples. But in a stream, a basic question is left open: \emph{which samples should drive each update?} Using all buffered samples blurs the update with irrelevant segments. Using only the latest segment makes the update noisy and unstable. The most useful samples are recent, aligned with the current physiological state, and reliable enough to learn from. We propose \textbf{RECAST} (REcent \& Context-Aware Sampling for TTA), a lightweight sampling module for buffered TTA frameworks. RECAST builds each adaptation batch from three signals: temporal recency, contextual similarity, and predictive reliability. It changes only which samples are used, leaving the model and the training objective unchanged. On two blood-pressure datasets, RECAST improves estimation accuracy and trend tracking over baselines and ablations. The per-patient gains are statistically significant on both datasets, with broad improvement on the regular benchmark and gains concentrated on the hardest patients in the emergency-department setting. RECAST stays practical, adding only sub-second latency per segment on a single GPU and CPU core.
2608.28271.paper_summary_zh: 串流生物信號在不同個體之間有所變化，並隨著時間漂移，因此在人群訓練的模型在長期監測中會失去準確性。測試時適應（TTA）通過在接收樣本上更新模型來實現在線個性化。但在一個串流中，一個基本問題仍然懸而未決：\emph{哪些樣本應該驅動每次更新？} 使用所有緩衝樣本會使更新與不相關的部分混淆。僅使用最新的片段則會使更新變得嘈雜且不穩定。最有用的樣本是最近的，與當前生理狀態對齊，並且足夠可靠以供學習。我們提出了\textbf{RECAST}（針對TTA的近期與上下文感知取樣），這是一個輕量級的取樣模塊，適用於緩衝的TTA框架。RECAST從三個信號構建每個適應批次：時間的近期性、上下文的相似性和預測的可靠性。它僅改變使用的樣本，而不改變模型和訓練目標。在兩個血壓數據集中，RECAST在基線和消融實驗中提高了估計準確性和趨勢追蹤。每位患者的增益在兩個數據集中都是統計上顯著的，並且在常規基準上有廣泛的改進，而增益集中在急診部門中最困難的患者身上。RECAST保持實用性，在單個GPU和CPU核心上每個片段僅增加亞秒級的延遲。
